info.title: Studio TV Organization Product Extension
info.description: Implemented owner-scoped PostgreSQL project organization and persisted inbox; independent additive extension. Frozen contracts/openapi.json/yaml remain unchanged.

get.description: Enforced product bounds:3 levels,1000 active folders per owner. No workspace/tool permission UI fields.
Owner comes exclusively from verified server session and supplied tv.access protection. Unknown fields/query keys rejected. No fixtures or simulated success.

get.description: Actual mixed folders/projects filtered before pagination. ALL absent folderId means root direct contents; CANVAS absent folderId means all ordinary projects for recent-home; folderId means direct children; FOLDER excludes projects. Pinned projects sort first. SIZE uses persisted UTF-8 graph bytes + active READY asset byte_size; folder bytes sum descendant ordinary projects. Project/asset SQL changes invalidate collection/folder revision.
